scenes.say: Same train. Same desk. Same promise that next year is different.
Escape velocity is the moment your money pays your bills without you.
And the number that decides it isn't your salary. It's what you keep.
Keep {s10} of what you earn, and you work {y10} years before your money can carry you.

scenes.say: Saving more works twice. Your pile grows faster, and the life it has to fund gets smaller.
The 9-to-5 isn't a salary problem. It's a spending problem wearing a suit.
